$comment: Settings for tools/cutout.mjs (D29, D30, D40, D46, D49, D50), merged with one tools/cutout.d/<slug>.json per case study. Targets = every image of a kind:drawing figure + extra + every configured image - exclude. Per-image options: mode ('ink' | 'object' with tol, grad, keep, bg), paper ([r,g,b] | 'field'), floor, knee, margin, band, clip [sides], erase [{id, x, y, w, h}], dark ('invert' | 'invert-accent' | 'field' | 'object'). The defaults 'halo' and 'alpha' are retired and read by nothing; they stay only because they are part of every sidecar's settings hash.

a map whose tree hatching fills its own frame: no paper inside it; graded alpha preserves the authored linework without adding a paper rectangle
